products.name: Zero Trust Architecture — Conditional Access Baseline & Rollout — Commercial
products.short_description: Build the Zero Trust identity perimeter — a complete, tested Conditional Access baseline rolled out without locking anyone out.
products.description:
Build the Zero Trust identity perimeter — a complete, tested Conditional Access baseline rolled out without locking anyone out.

Zero Trust starts at identity, and Conditional Access is the engine — but one bad policy locks out the tenant. This solution designs a complete CA baseline (personas, device/compliance requirements, risk-based access, app protection), validates it in report-only mode, and rolls it out in waves with break-glass protection.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Persona-based CA design (admins, internals, externals, guests, service accounts)
  • Baseline policies — MFA, compliant/hybrid device, risk-based, session controls
  • Report-only validation and What-If testing before enforcement
  • Break-glass accounts and exclusion strategy
  • Staged rollout waves with monitoring and rollback

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A production Zero Trust CA baseline enforcing least-privilege access — deployed safely, with no lockouts.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTZTCA-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Conditional Access policies, legacy auth, and licensing
    • ENTZTCA-Report.ps1 — report-only impact analysis from sign-in logs before you enforce
    • ENTZTCA-Set-Baseline.ps1 — create the numbered CA baseline in REPORT-ONLY with break-glass excluded
    • ENTZTCA-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build and preview the persona, break-glass, and pilot groups
    • ENTZTCA-Validate.ps1 — confirm the baseline exists, its state, and break-glass exclusion

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
